steps.label: compile checks
cmd: out=$(gcc -std=c11 -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=undefined -Iinclude -Isrc src/*.c __checker__/check.c -o chk 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E '^(src|include)/[^ ]*:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: (fatal )?error'; echo 'the hidden checks do not compile against this library: keep the API of include/ini.h (README.md)'; exit 1; }
